resources.string: This is NamelessNanashi\'s personal build of the Flipper Zero app.
It is not made, endorsed or supported by Flipper Devices. Don\'t contact their support about it.
It is built for Momentum firmware and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk and keep a backup of your SD card.
It collects no data. The app catalog, remotes and key sharing still use Flipper Devices\' servers.
Updates come from GitHub releases (Obtainium), not Google Play.
Bluetooth: on the Flipper, Settings > Bluetooth > ON, then pick it below.
USB (faster): plug the Flipper into this phone with a data cable, then tap the button below. No pairing needed.
Turn On Bluetooth on your Flipper
Apps using Bluetooth are required to enable location access. **No location data will be gathered or stored**
Apps using Bluetooth are required to enable location access. No location data will be gathered or stored
Bluetooth on Your Phone is Turned Off
Bluetooth access is required to confirm the connection between your phone and Flipper Device
Check Bluetooth connection on your Flipper and retry
Unable to connect Flipper. Try again or go to Help.
Connection was canceled or the pairing code was entered incorrectly
Wireless. Pair once, then the app reconnects on its own whenever the Flipper is nearby.
Turn on Bluetooth on the Flipper
On the Flipper: Settings → Bluetooth → Bluetooth: ON.
[How to turn on Bluetooth on the Flipper](https://flipp.dev/bluetooth-on)
Turn on Bluetooth on the phone
Allow the Nearby devices permission when the app asks (Location on Android 11 and older). Without it the app can\'t find the Flipper.
Pick your Flipper in the list
The list shows Flippers by name. Keep the Flipper unlocked and within a few metres of the phone.
The Flipper shows a 6-digit code. Enter it, or confirm it when the phone shows the same code. The first sync starts after pairing.
Remove the Flipper from the phone\'s Bluetooth settings, and on the Flipper choose Settings → Bluetooth → Forget All Paired Devices. Then pair again from this app.
Only one app may talk to the Flipper at a time. The official Flipper app or qFlipper sharing the connection can corrupt files.
Much faster than Bluetooth for big transfers and app installs. No pairing needed.
USB-C to USB-C, or a USB-C cable with an OTG adapter. Charge-only cables do not work. The phone must support USB host (OTG); most USB-C phones do.
Plug the Flipper into the phone
The Flipper must be on and unlocked, not in DFU or update mode.
Android asks whether this app may use the Flipper. Tap OK. Tick "Always open" to skip the question next time.
The app switches to the cable on its own while the Flipper is plugged in, and back to Bluetooth (if paired) when you unplug it.
Unplug and plug the cable back in, try another cable, and close qFlipper or any terminal app that may hold the Flipper\'s USB port.
No Flipper found on USB. Check the cable and allow USB access, then try again.
These help with both Bluetooth and USB.
Hold Left and Back for 5 seconds.
Once connected, the Device tab offers Momentum firmware updates. Old firmware may not connect.
Turn Bluetooth off and on again, or restart the phone.
New builds are published on GitHub (Obtainium picks them up).
